findings.title: No tool declares annotations
findings.fix: Annotate every tool; mark reads readOnlyHint: true.

findings.title: tools/list works without credentials
findings.detail: Fine for public read-only servers; otherwise require OAuth 2.1 / bearer auth.
findings.fix: Return 401 with WWW-Authenticate for protected servers.

findings.title: Requests with a foreign Origin header are accepted
findings.detail: The MCP Streamable HTTP spec says servers MUST validate Origin to prevent DNS-rebinding attacks, which matters most for localhost servers.
findings.fix: Reject requests whose Origin is not on an allow-list (403).
